req.title: Reject limit above cap
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the limit parameter exceeds the maximum allowed.

doc.reasoning: The endpoint GET /tasks/ declares limit with Query(100, ge=1, le=1000). Any value > 1000 must yield HTTP 422. We need: (1) a positive case with a valid limit (e.g. 500, well inside the range) to confirm 200 is returned; (2) a negative case with a clearly over-cap value (e.g. 1001) to confirm 422; (3) boundary cases at exactly 1000 (max allowed → 200) and 1001 (one above cap → 422). We also test limit=1 (minimum boundary) and limit=0 (below minimum → 422) to cover both ends of the ge=1 constraint. Assertions use exact status codes and, where possible, exact response shapes to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_limit_valid_midrange_returns_200
expected: Response body is a JSON array
trace: R-TASK-007: valid limit must not trigger 422
EP: representative value from valid partition [1..1000]
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app import models
from app.database import engine

models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
client = TestClient(app)

def test_limit_valid_midrange_returns_200():
    r = client.get("/tasks/?limit=500")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body, list)
    assert len(body) == 20

test_limit_valid_midrange_returns_200()
